lines.text: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him;
You are enraged by Your anointed one.
You have renounced the covenant with Your servant
and sullied his crown in the dust.
You have broken down all his walls;
You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
All who pass by plunder him;
he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
You have exalted the right hand of his foes;
You have made all his enemies rejoice.
You have bent the edge of his sword
and have not sustained him in battle.
and cast his throne to the ground.
You have cut short the days of his youth;
You have covered him with shame.

pictures.scene: Vasily Perov, The Last Tavern at the Town Gate — the sledges left standing in the frozen dusk outside the gate while the light goes out of the sky, now, however, You have spurned and rejected him, You are enraged by Your anointed one
pictures.name: pd_perov_verworpen

pictures.scene: Jan Matejko, Stańczyk — the king's jester sitting alone in his red with the news in his hand and the party still going on behind him, You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust
pictures.name: pd_matejko_kroon

pictures.scene: John Constable, Hadleigh Castle — the broken towers standing open to the weather over the mouth of the river, You have broken down all his walls, You have reduced his strongholds to rubble
pictures.name: pd_constable_muren

pictures.scene: Egbert van der Poel, A View of Delft after the Explosion — the people picking over the wreck of their own street with everything they had lying open in it, all who pass by plunder him, he has become a reproach to his neighbors
pictures.name: pd_vanderpoel_plundering

pictures.scene: Lawrence Alma-Tadema, The Triumph of Titus — the conquerors coming down the steps in procession with the spoils of the temple carried in front of them, You have exalted the right hand of his foes, You have made all his enemies rejoice
pictures.name: pd_almatadema_tegenstanders

pictures.scene: Eugène Delacroix, The Battle of Nancy — the duke going down under the horses in the snow with his sword no use to him, You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_zwaard

pictures.scene: Karl von Piloty, Seni at the Dead Body of Wallenstein — the great commander lying stretched out on the floor of his own room with one old man standing over him, You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground
pictures.name: pd_piloty_glans

pictures.scene: Mihály Munkácsy, The Condemned Cell — the young man sitting silent in his chains while the whole village files in to look at him, You have cut short the days of his youth, You have covered him with shame
pictures.name: pd_munkacsy_schande

pictures.scene: Isaac Levitan, Vladimirka — the long empty road that the prisoners walked, running away over the grey land to nothing, how long, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_levitan_hoelang
